functions.name: update-user-email
functions.description: Replace a managed user's email address with an address in a verified target domain. The new address is considered verified, and the call invalidates all active sessions.

email.description: Replacement email address in an already verified target domain. The user part and each domain label must be at most 255 characters. Control and null characters are forbidden. Sent exactly as supplied, without trimming or case conversion.

accountId.description: Opaque account ID of the managed user whose email will be replaced.

FunctionInput_atlassian_admin_updateuser.description: Managed user account and replacement email address in an already verified target domain.

email.description: Replacement address submitted successfully; this is an echo, not a profile read-back.

tags.instructions: Use this only for an administrative email change, with the user's account ID and a target address in a domain your administrator has already verified. The connection needs the `email.set` management privilege and authority over the user and target domain. `list-domains` can inspect domain claim states. This replaces the email and invalidates all active sessions; it is not an invitation or verification-email request. Do not blindly replay an uncertain result.
